text: With great power comes great responsibility.
context: Uncle Ben's dying words to Peter Parker, establishing the moral core of Spider-Man's character across nearly every adaptation in film, television, and comics.

text: You have a gift. A power that most people will never understand. And with that power comes a responsibility. A responsibility to use it to help people, to protect them, not to hurt them.
context: The full context of the responsibility lesson, emphasizing protection over personal gain.

text: I can't just stand by and watch bad things happen. I have to do something. I have to be better.
context: Peter's realization that ignoring his power makes him responsible for the consequences.

text: With great power comes great responsibility. Don't ever forget that.
context: The direct, memorable phrasing that has echoed through generations of Spider-Man stories.

text: These are the years when a man changes into the man he's going to become the rest of his life. Just be careful who you change into.
context: Ben's fatherly warning to Peter in the car after the school fight.

text: Whatever life holds in store for me, I will never forget these words: 'With great power comes great responsibility.'
context: Peter's closing narration, carrying Ben's lesson forward.

text: This is my gift, my curse. Who am I? I'm Spider-Man.
context: The final lines of Peter's closing narration.
May voicing the Parkers' ethic of looking out for others.

text: Who am I? You sure you want to know? The story of my life is not for the faint of heart.
context: Peter's opening narration, framing the story as a lesson learned.

text: You have a gift. You have power. And with great power, there must also come great responsibility.
context: May restating Ben's lesson to Peter before her death.

text: If you could do good things for other people, you had a moral obligation to do those things. That's what's at stake here. Not choice. Responsibility.
context: Ben's rebuke when Peter shirks helping others — the lesson Peter ignores until it is too late.
